env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A tuple of N values destructures into N targets whatever the element
# types are: a tuple, an option of a value type or of a pointer type,
# and a named tuple. The tuple is a literal or a variable, and the
# host is a short declaration, an assignment, a var declaration or a
# return that forwards it to a function with N results. The module
# runs natively, ejects, and the ejected module builds and runs with go
# and with go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272 and prints the same ok lines.
cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_tuple_destructure_elements.lgo m/main.lgo
cd m
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_tuple_destructure_elements.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_tuple_destructure_elements.out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/eject_tuple_destructure_elements.out
cd ../..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/tupledestructureelements

go 1.27
